messages.subject: Lyra – SOW-1 milestones and M&V sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Daniel,

Finalising SOW-1. Please confirm the milestone dates work: M2 baseline at Effective Date + 8 weeks, all 11 sites in managed operation by ED + 22 weeks, implementation acceptance at ED + 24 weeks. The M&V uses IPMVP Option C normalised for production volume and weather, which drives the 18% shared-savings calculation. OK to lock?

Elena

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
